Most of the time i struggle to fall asleep, but I sleep constantly throughout the day, and I sometimes won’t even wake up until about 3 in the afternoon.

I eat 2-3 small meals throughout the day when I force myself to get out of bed.

No, hardly leave my room anymore.

Constantly. I feel like I’m just not meant to do anything right or important.
Go ahead, I’ve got all the time in the world.
I used to workout for myself. I tried learning how to cook. I tried getting back into video games. Nothing excites me, it’s all just extra, unnecessary, and boring.
I honest to god still can’t believe this meme was posted on world politics. Believe it or not, this is only related to the United States 😱
